sūdātōrium, sūdātōriī n.

noun, second declension

sauna, sweating room

Examples

  • sūdātōriīs, in quae siccus vapor corpora exhausūrus inclūditur

    sweating rooms, where dry heat is shut in to drain the bodySeneca, Ep. 51.6

  • In sūdātōriō nimis calidum est.

    It’s too hot in the sauna.composed

  • Post sūdātōrium in piscīnam frīgidam dēsiliāmus!

    After the sauna, let’s jump into the cold pool!composed

Other words

  • assa, assōrum n. — dry sweating room

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Cic. Q. fr. 3.1.2

  • Lacōnicum, Lacōnicī n. — dry-heat room

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Cic. Att. 4.10.2; Vitruvius

See also spa, hot room, cold room.
